description: Estimate biochemical support present in an individual spectrum group or cluster
typical_use_case: class profiles cohort summaries and cluster interpretation
notes: Best when the question is what is present rather than what changed.

description: Estimate biochemical change relative to a baseline comparator or matched background
typical_use_case: perturbation panels dose series case-control contrasts and matched comparisons
notes: Necessary when raw support is dominated by shared background and only differences are biologically meaningful.
